answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 24487 Country: India Title: As per the Islamic law can a person study the course of Chartered Accountant ? Question: As per the Islamic law can a person study the course of Chartered Accountant ? Answer ID: 24487 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1237/964/D=1431) Yes, it is lawful to study the course of chartered accountant. However, it will not be lawful to record interest-based accounts. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
